text.en: Most pet owners praise the groomers for their friendly, accommodating demeanor and clear styling advice. Clients appreciate the team's thoughtful recommendations for different coat types, although one reviewer was dissatisfied when a scheduled appointment was cancelled on short notice.

Dog and cat owners report excellent grooming results, noting that pets come out looking clean, well-trimmed, and neatly brushed without clipper burn. Multiple clients highlight that groomers faithfully recreate requested cuts and take extra care when bathing sensitive cockapoos.

Reviewers emphasize that the groomers handle dogs with genuine gentleness and patience, ensuring animals leave relaxed and happy with tails wagging. Owners of elderly dogs particularly appreciate the considerate approach adapted to senior pets with special mobility needs.

q.en: Do they groom cats as well as dogs?

a.en: Yes, clients mention bringing cats for haircuts and coat care alongside dogs of all sizes.

q.en: How do groomers handle pets with sensitive skin?

a.en: Reviewers report that groomers use gentle techniques that avoid razor burns and skin irritation on delicate coats.

q.en: Where is the grooming salon located?

a.en: HappyPets Grooming operates inside HappyPets Pantry on Sherbourne Street in downtown Toronto.

q.en: Is advance booking required for grooming appointments?

a.en: Yes, clients recommend reserving appointments ahead of time because slots fill up quickly during peak hours.
